ru.title: Аккаунт
ru.text: Случайный идентификатор и хеш номера аккаунта. Email храним, только если вы сами его указали.

sr.title: Nalog
sr.text: Nasumični identifikator i heš broja naloga. Email čuvamo samo ako ste ga sami uneli.

en.title: Account
en.text: A random identifier and a hash of your account number. Email only if you chose to add one.

ru.title: Подписка
ru.text: Тариф, даты начала и окончания (без времени), лимиты.

sr.title: Pretplata
sr.text: Paket, datumi početka i isteka (bez vremena), ograničenja.

en.title: Subscription
en.text: Plan, start and end dates (no time of day), limits.

ru.title: Счётчик трафика
ru.text: Одно суммарное число байт за текущий расчётный период, без истории, сайтов и времени.

sr.title: Brojač saobraćaja
sr.text: Jedan zbirni broj bajtova za tekući obračunski period, bez istorije, sajtova i vremena.

en.title: Traffic counter
en.text: One running byte total for the current billing period, with no history, sites or times.

ru.title: Устройства
ru.text: Хеш ключа устройства и дата последнего использования (без времени); нужны для лимита устройств.

sr.title: Uređaji
sr.text: Heš ključa uređaja i datum poslednje upotrebe (bez vremena); potrebni su za ograničenje broja uređaja.

en.title: Devices
en.text: A hash of each device key and the last-used date (no time), used for the device limit.

ru.title: Платежи
ru.text: Записи о заказах и оплатах хранятся столько, сколько требует закон. Не связаны с использованием VPN.

sr.title: Plaćanja
sr.text: Zapisi o porudžbinama i plaćanjima čuvaju se onoliko dugo koliko zakon zahteva. Nisu povezani sa korišćenjem VPN-a.

en.title: Payments
en.text: Order and payment records are kept as long as the law requires. Not linked to VPN usage.

ru.title: Поддержка
ru.text: Переписка и вложения хранятся 30 дней после закрытия обращения, диагностика 7 дней и только с вашего согласия.

sr.title: Podrška
sr.text: Prepiska i prilozi čuvaju se 30 dana nakon zatvaranja zahteva, dijagnostika 7 dana i samo uz vašu saglasnost.

en.title: Support
en.text: Messages and attachments are kept for 30 days after the ticket closes; diagnostics for 7 days and only with your consent.

ru.title: Отчёты о сбоях
ru.text: Только если вы включили отправку или нажали «Отправить»: место сбоя в коде, версия, ОС и день. Без аккаунта, IP-адреса и адресов сайтов, хранятся 90 дней.

sr.title: Izveštaji o padu
sr.text: Samo ako ste uključili slanje ili pritisnuli „Pošalji”: mesto pada u kodu, verzija, OS i dan. Bez naloga, IP adrese i adresa sajtova, čuvaju se 90 dana.

en.title: Crash reports
en.text: Only if you turned sending on or pressed Send: where the code crashed, the version, OS and day. No account, IP address or site addresses; kept for 90 days.

en: The IP address you connect from
Sites you visit, DNS queries and traffic content
Traffic volume per session or site
ru: Посещаемые сайты, DNS-запросы и содержимое трафика
Объём трафика по сессиям и сайтам
sr: IP adresa sa koje se povezujete
Posećeni sajtovi, DNS upiti i sadržaj saobraćaja
Količina saobraćaja po sesijama i sajtovima

retention.purpose: Account identity. Anonymous by default; email optional (recovery only).

retention.retention: until removal; auto-removed after 90 days unused
retention.purpose: Device limit. last_used_on is a DATE (24h granularity); no IP, no timestamps.
Service entitlement
Transport credentials; passwords encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM, key from secret manager)

retention.retention: until expiry (max 31 days) or revocation; purged daily
retention.purpose: Session continuation bound to a device key. expires_on is a DATE so login time is not recoverable.
Enforce traffic limit; cumulative within billing period, no per-delta history
Plan catalogue (no user data)
Which nodes (locations) a plan includes; the client shows them as its location list
Plan prices per currency (catalogue, no user data)
What was bought for which account. account_id becomes NULL when the account is deleted; the bookkeeping record stays.
Payment attempts. No card data, no wallet addresses, no e-mail or phone; raw_payload keeps allowlisted provider fields only (superadmin, audited).
Double-entry journal (account = ledger account such as revenue, never a user)
Exactly-once marker (an order extends a subscription once)
Provider notifications as triggers (deduplication). The source address is compared in memory and never stored.
Transactional outbox (fulfilment, refunds, alerts); payload holds ids only

retention.retention: 90 days (purge loop); at most 500 reports per signature
retention.purpose: Anonymous crash reports, sent only with the user's consent (setting or a manual "Send"). No account, device, IP or session; the day of the crash only. The stack trace is sanitized on the device and again on the server (addresses, host names, e-mails, UUIDs, tokens, long numbers, argument words, absolute paths removed).

retention.retention: 30 days after closing; deleted with the account
retention.purpose: Support requests the user opened; summary is a factual template for staff (plan, last payment state, attachment count)
Conversation as written by the user, the AI and staff. Only redacted text is sent to the AI processor; message texts never go to logs or the staff audit.
Screenshots (re-encoded, metadata stripped) and diagnostics (redacted on the device and on the server), encrypted with the data key
Knowledge base (no user data); the AI cites published articles

Node registry. Secrets (REALITY key, obfs password, TLS key) encrypted at rest. agent_report_at is node health bookkeeping, not user activity. ssh_target is the deployment endpoint of the node server (host, port, account, pinned host key); apply_error is a sanitised agent message.
Versions of the editable, non-secret node parameters (transport editor) for review and restore
Deploy, redeploy, decommission and rollout jobs started from the panel. Steps hold short redacted messages; never passwords, tokens or keys.
One-time node enrolment tokens (HMAC only)
Capacity planning. Node totals only; active_users NULL below k=10 (k-anonymity).
ACME account of the panel per CA directory; key encrypted
Pending HTTP-01 challenges handed to node agents
Signed client release metadata for self-update (signed offline)
Record of consents (crash reports, AI support notice, email)
Proof that export/erasure requests were handled. account_ref is the random account id; nothing else about the account survives erasure.
Staff authentication with mandatory TOTP
Staff sessions (revocable, device-bound)
Accountability of STAFF actions (not VPN user logs). Append-only, hash-chained.
Migration bookkeeping
Operations/debugging (no IP, no User-Agent, no query, no path parameters)
Application events; every record passes the redaction handler

retention.retention: ring buffer 2x2 MiB; wiped on exit by default
retention.purpose: Local troubleshooting on the user's device; redacted (incl. hostnames); never uploaded without consent
node-agent health only; sing-box log.disabled=true on nodes
Access/refresh tokens and device private key (file 0600)
Last verified signed profile, to connect when the API is blocked
Only the selected outbound (store_selected); no fake-IP or DNS cache on disk

User preferences (language, LAN access, kill switch, auto-switch, chosen location, split-tunnel rules, automatic Russian-zone bypass switch, DoH resolver choice and custom DoH URL, connect at start, automatic crash report sending). Never sent to the server; DNS queries go to the chosen resolver through the tunnel, so it sees the node address.

retention.retention: until sent or deleted by the user; at most 10 reports, 30 days
retention.purpose: Crash reports of veilond, the cores, the desktop UI or the Android app, sanitized before they are written; listed in the app with the exact text that would be sent. Sent only with consent.

retention.retention: until the next start of the same program
retention.purpose: Raw Go runtime output of a fatal error of veilond, the desktop UI or the Android bridge (file 0600 in the private state or cache directory), read once at the next start, sanitized into client.crash_queue and truncated. Empty unless the process crashed.

retention.retention: until the user turns it off
retention.purpose: The "start at login" entry of the desktop UI (XDG autostart file, macOS LaunchAgent or the HKCU Run value) holding only the program path; Android has no file (boot receiver).
Last known addresses of node and API host names (same names as in the cached profile), used only when the kill switch blocks DNS
Verified installer of a newer version (SHA-256 checked against signed metadata), in the runtime directory

retention.retention: tmpfs until restart; agent key until node decommission
retention.purpose: Rendered sing-box config (users as node-scoped pseudonyms) on tmpfs; agent key and certificate in the state volume. No logs, no counters on disk.

processors.Purpose: AI first-line support (redacted message excerpts, KB snippets)
